headline: Can GE HealthCare Sustain Growth in Q2 Amid Persistent Cost Headwinds?
summary: GE HealthCare heads into Q2 earnings season with solid revenue drivers, but inflation and tariff costs may keep margins under pressure before an expected second-half recovery.
